items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: I think the three horn players, which were me, Bobby Capers on alto and Hubert Laws on tenor, just somehow decided hey let’s do that.

ctx.x: You almost feel like oh no the dancers are going to fall down. But you know of course one comes back in where it’s supposed to.

Yeah. I’m not sure exactly how that came about but I think the three horn players, which were me, Bobby Capers on alto and Hubert Laws on tenor, just somehow decided hey let’s do that. I think there’s no other explanation I can think of.
So your trumpet solo is so perfect for the song. Do you recall thinking I’m going to keep my bop chops in check sort of? And play these cool riffs because this is what the song requires?
